verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official CLI (@usebruno/cli) documented for running collections, generating reports, and CI/CD integration, with hands-on probe confirming it installs from npm and runs headlessly, plus official Docker images for CI use. This is a general-purpose API testing CLI rather than one purpose-built for AI-agent workflows, so missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-oriented CLI features or documentation framing it for agentic/AI-native use cases.
